FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How do I download an SDS from Blick?
Find the product above and click Download. All SDS are free PDF downloads — no account or sign-up needed.
Are these Safety Data Sheets current?
Yes. We update SDS when formulations change. Contact us if you need a specific revision date.
Do you have SDS for Jet Lube or tooling products?
Contact us — we can supply Jet Lube and partner product SDS on request.
What products does Blick carry SDS for?
HDD Gel, Construct Gel, Bentonite Plug, Carry Flow, Carry Foam, Carry Max, Clay Control, Clay Dissolve, Defoam, Detergent, Filter High, Filter Low, Loss Swell, One Stop, Torque Down, Swell Stop Dry, and Swell Stop Liquid — all available as free PDF downloads on this page.
